title: The Tracking Log
summary: Lyra has been following the cult cell that killed her mother for two years. She has a name, a location, and a problem: she cannot act alone without destroying the evidence trail. She needs help she does not know how to ask for.

onComplete.text: She produces a folded journal from her pack. Two years of notation: dates, locations, cult cell activity, one name circled in red. 'I found where he operates. I cannot go there alone without tipping them. I have been waiting for a reason to trust someone.' She closes the journal. 'This is me trusting.'

phases.label: Find the hidden scout post Lyra marked on her map

onComplete.text: The cache is exactly where she said it would be: hollow oak at the fen-edge, sealed watertight. Inside: a ledger of cult supply routes in handwriting she recognizes as her mother's. Her mother was tracking them before Lyra was.

phases.label: Confront the cult operator Lyra has been tracking

onComplete.text: It ends badly for the cult operator and incompletely for Lyra — the information matters more than the closure, and she knows it, and that is the part that costs something.

phases.label: Help Lyra decide what to do with her mother's ledger

onComplete.text: She gives the ledger to the guild. 'She built it for this. I am not going to stop carrying it.' She does not say thank you. She does not need to.
